category_title: Struggling readers who view reading as a process of remembering and repeating
scenario_title: Scripted phonics intervention and nonsense syllables
minimal_context: The student is participating in a small group phonics intervention where she is asked to identify letter sounds and read nonsense syllables from a scripted manual.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: This is m. It says /m/. What does it say?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: [raising her hand] Last night, I found a—

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the page. Try reading this word: lom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try the next word on the page: af.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: This is m. It says /m/. What does it say?

STUDENT: [raising her hand] Last night, I found a—

TUTOR: Let's look at the page. Try reading this word: lom.

STUDENT: lock... lock... lock-m.

TUTOR: Try the next word on the page: af.

STUDENT: Is af an animal?

task.content: Practicing letter sounds (specifically the sound /o/) and reading nonsense syllables (e.g., 'lom') in an intensive Title I intervention program using a scripted manual

context.materials: Scripted manual, page with o, a, c, and I printed in large font, randomly positioned
context.social_setting: Small group with teacher and classmate
context.time_context: During a weekly literacy assessment and scripted phonics lesson

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked to provide a requested sound or read a nonsense syllable
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Raises hand to share a personal narrative instead of providing the requested sound. Questions the meaning of nonsense syllables. Reads nonsense syllables incorrectly by guessing real words ('lock,' 'lock,' 'lock-m')

behavior_patterns.condition: When attempting to participate in a scripted Title I phonics lesson
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Attempts to share a personal narrative instead of providing the requested sound
